I’ve been feeling really tired lately, like I’m stuck in a loop. Every night I lie in bed, and my body just doesn’t settle—my legs are sore, like they’re constantly tense, and I get this dizzy feeling, like the world is tilting. I don’t even know why it’s happening. And when I finally get to sleep, I wake up dazed and can’t remember how I got to school yesterday. It’s like my mind and body are fighting each other. I don’t know if it’s the pain, the stress, or something deeper. I just feel so overwhelmed and confused about what’s going on.  

What do you think? Is it okay to just… sit with that feeling instead of trying to fix it right away?
